_note: tapFrac are normalized SCREEN coords computed from the real hierarchy, not guessed. World taps (the three sectors) need no correction because the camera fills the screen: offset = laneWidth / (2 * halfWidth) = 0.8/3 = 0.2667, and the hit line sits at (halfH - HIT_Y)/(2*halfH) = 0.81 - both independent of aspect. UI taps DO need the letterbox correction: the MAIN canvas expands to 1242x2760 on a 1080x2400 device while AspecterSA is pinned to 1242x2688, so a panel fraction u lands at (36 + u*2688)/2760 of the screen from the bottom.
